task.description: Diagnose ISS-0639: build.zig test-integration-svc step uses main_test.zig (full ~700-test suite) instead of a scoped SVC shim. Category A (source wrong). Determine exact fix.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified with file+line reference
Correct set of SVC test files enumerated
Fix design documented (svc_test_root.zig shim + build.zig change + umbrella wiring)

result.summary: Category A (source wrong, build tooling). Root cause: build.zig defines svc_integration_tests with root_source_file = tests/integration/main_test.zig (line 2481), the same root as the full ~700-test umbrella suite. The step description claims SVC-01..SVC-04 scope but no scoped shim file exists. Twin defect to ISS-0104/GH-362 (env step, resolved via env_test_root.zig). Four SVC test files confirmed in tests/integration/: svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig, svc02_plugin_dispatch_scope_test.zig, svc03_definition_activation_scope_test.zig, svc04_admin_api_test.zig. Additionally: run_svc_integration_tests is NOT wired to test_integration_others_step (umbrella), so the svc suite is currently never exercised by the umbrella run. Fix: (1) create tests/integration/svc_test_root.zig importing only those 4 files (mirror env_test_root.zig pattern with ISS-0639/GH-629 annotation), (2) update build.zig line 2481 root_source_file from main_test.zig to svc_test_root.zig, (3) add test_integration_others_step.dependOn(&run_svc_integration_tests.step) after the env umbrella wire line (~2530). No test source files need to be added or removed.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER (Step 2) -- fix design artefact
